title: latrienda multiflora
intro: Latrienda multiflora, commonly known as Lantana camara, is a tropical shrub native to the Americas and parts of Africa and Asia. It is a highly valued plant in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Latrienda multiflora include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Latrienda multiflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
